metadata.description: Marketplace for the iterate-on-docs plugin: refine markdown and HTML documents with Claude by trading turns.

plugins.name: iterate-on-docs
plugins.description: Refine a document with Claude by trading turns. You edit the file and leave instructions for Claude in it; Claude applies your edits' intent and follows the instructions; repeat until it's good. Works on markdown and static HTML. Also draws a visual HTML overview of a project.
